title: Relaxation Character of Glass Transition in Binary Oxide Glasses Containing Lead and Boron
content: We have examined the temperature dependence of the viscosity of lead and boron containing binary oxide glasses in the context of transition from the liquid to the vitreous state, including analysis of kinetic criterion of glass transition. Both the temperature interval determining the glass transition and the structural relaxation time were found near the glass transition temperature of PbO-SiO2, PbO-GeO2, B2O3-Bi2O3, B2O3-Li2O, B2O3-BaO, B2O3-Na2O3 glasses based on Williams-Landel-Ferry equation.
